about: The regions a view asks that nothing renders are named: none of bound's own, whose names are one list tsc holds REGIONS to, and none a capsule the place can run declares. unrendered returns them and renders nothing; whoever dispatches the view refuses it whole by those names. While the wire's list of regions stands it changes no page.
